matchstick.title: Move vertical I-stick between numerals
matchstick.principle: If the numeric discrepancy is exactly one, transferring a single vertical stick that forms an I from one numeral to another can adjust their values by ±1 while keeping both symbols valid.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is close to correct and a one‑unit adjustment could balance it.
matchstick.example: Moving a vertical stick from an I and leaving the source numeral empty, resulting in an invalid symbol.

matchstick.title: Prefer intra-character stick relocation
matchstick.principle: First try to change a character by moving a stick within the same symbol (e.g., turning X into V or I) before considering moves that affect other characters.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is incorrect and a simple shape change might fix it.
matchstick.example: Removing one diagonal from an X and leaving a single diagonal, which is not a valid numeral.

matchstick.title: Validate symbols after stick move
matchstick.principle: After relocating a stick, check that every character (numerals and operators) remains a recognized Roman numeral or operator.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Immediately after any stick relocation, before evaluating arithmetic.
matchstick.example: Turning a plus sign into a minus but forgetting to verify that the resulting minus is a valid operator.

matchstick.title: Avoid single angled sticks
matchstick.principle: A lone diagonal stick does not represent any Roman numeral; diagonal sticks must appear in pairs to form V or X.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Whenever a move involves a diagonal stick.
matchstick.example: Removing one diagonal from a V and leaving a single diagonal, which is invalid.

matchstick.title: Convert plus to minus by removing vertical stick
matchstick.principle: A plus sign consists of a vertical and a horizontal stick; removing the vertical stick turns it into a minus sign.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When a plus sign is present and its vertical stick could be useful elsewhere.
matchstick.example: Removing the vertical stick from '+' but discarding it instead of reusing it, violating the move‑exactly‑one‑stick rule.

matchstick.title: Create new numeral by reordering stick
matchstick.principle: A detached stick can be placed as a separate character to form a new valid Roman numeral (e.g., a single I).
matchstick.when_to_apply: When you have an extra stick after a transformation and can form a standalone numeral.
matchstick.example: Leaving a stray stick that does not correspond to any numeral, resulting in an invalid equation.

matchstick.title: Consider inter-character stick relocation
matchstick.principle: If no intra‑character move yields a valid equality, explore moving a stick from one character to another, ensuring both remain valid.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After exhausting intra‑character options without success.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from one numeral to another and creating an invalid numeral like a lone diagonal.

matchstick.title: Augment numeral with vertical stick from operator
matchstick.principle: After converting a plus sign to a minus by removing its vertical stick, attach that stick to a nearby numeral to increase its value by one (e.g., adding an I).
matchstick.when_to_apply: When a freed vertical stick can be used to form a valid numeral that helps balance the equation.
matchstick.example: Attaching the vertical stick to a numeral in a way that creates an invalid shape, such as adding it to X to form a non‑Roman symbol.

matchstick.title: Verify arithmetic after stick move
matchstick.principle: After forming new Roman numerals and operators, compute their numeric values to ensure the equation holds.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After any transformation, before finalizing the answer.
matchstick.example: Accepting a visually correct equation without checking that the numeric values actually match.

matchstick.title: Move vertical stick from plus to numeral to convert plus to minus and augment numeral
matchstick.principle: When a plus sign is present, moving its vertical stick to a numeral (typically the left‑hand side) simultaneously turns the plus into a minus and adds an I to the numeral, often correcting the equality.
matchstick.when_to_apply: If the equation is of the form A = B + C and the numeric imbalance can be fixed by increasing A by 1 and changing + to –.
matchstick.example: Moving the vertical stick from '+' to 'I' but forgetting to change '+' to '-', leaving an invalid operator.

matchstick.description: Overlooking intra‑character transformations (e.g., X→V) before inter‑character moves
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model tends to consider moving sticks between symbols first, missing simpler shape changes within a single character.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Always attempt intra‑character stick relocations before exploring inter‑character moves.

matchstick.description: Assuming sticks retain their orientation and not rotating horizontals to verticals (or vice versa) when repositioning
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model treats sticks as fixed in orientation, overlooking that a stick can be reoriented when placed elsewhere.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: When moving a stick, consider all possible orientations that make the target character valid.

matchstick.description: Not evaluating the arithmetic result after each candidate transformation
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model focuses on visual validity of symbols and forgets to check numeric correctness.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: After any stick move, compute the numeric values of both sides to confirm the equality.

matchstick.description: Assuming operator swaps (e.g., = ↔ -) automatically solve the puzzle
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model expects that changing an operator will balance the equation without further adjustments.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Treat operator changes as part of a broader search; verify arithmetic after the swap.

matchstick.description: Ignoring the I↔L transformation (adding/removing a horizontal stick to/from an I)
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model does not consider that an I can become an L by adding a horizontal stick, missing a possible solution.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: When a horizontal stick is available, check whether attaching it to an I creates a valid L numeral.
